values.value: Money owed back to a family is recorded as a credit note (overpayment, cheaper class after a transfer, withdrawal or goodwill). Credit is used automatically on the family's next invoice when auto-apply is {{Setting:Auto_Apply_Credit}}. A credit balance can be refunded. Refunds up to {{Setting:Refund_Auto_Approve_Limit}} are approved automatically; larger refunds need approval by someone other than the person who requested them (finance, administrators, branch managers with the approve refunds permission). The refund is marked paid with the bank or UPI reference once the money has been sent.
